correctness.rationale: Exact marking of one fixed point gives Cov(F_n,B_n)=mu_{n-1}+1/(n-1)-mu_n. The standard insertion construction yields Cov(F_{m+1},B_{m+1})=(1-T_m)/(m+1), and two disjoint enumerated partition families prove T_m>1 for every odd m>=9 and even m>=14. Exact rational partition coefficients give all remaining positive/negative base cases. The Shepp-Lloyd ranked-cycle limit and Ford equal-long-cycle bound show T_m/m -> gamma_2; hence covariance -> -gamma_2. Script verifies two independent exact rational constructions, the class increment identity through m=14, the harmonic bounds, and 46,232 individual permutations. No finite check is called an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines a sharp full-range finite covariance sign for two canonical permutation observables, with a surprising exact change of sign at n=6 and persistent negative limit -0.20958090. It connects local one-cycles to the global second-ranked cycle and requires a substantive disjoint cycle-type lower-bound argument; it is not a marginal restatement, arbitrary sliced invariant, or finite table alone.
